facts.founders_experience: Clari was founded by Andy Byrne (CEO), Venkat Rangan (CTO), and Prof. Ashwin Ram (Chief Scientist). Andy Byrne previously co-founded Clearwell Systems, a leader in e-discovery software, which was acquired by Symantec in 2011. Venkat Rangan has a strong background in distributed systems and AI, while Ashwin Ram is a renowned AI researcher with expertise in natural language processing and machine learning.

key_leaders.name: Andy Byrne
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & CEO
key_leaders.background: Co-founded Clearwell Systems (acquired by Symantec), former VP at Symantec, and holds an MBA from Harvard Business School.

key_leaders.name: Venkat Rangan
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & CTO
key_leaders.background: Expert in distributed systems and AI, former engineering leader at Clearwell Systems.

key_leaders.name: Ashwin Ram
key_leaders.title: Co-Founder & Chief Scientist
key_leaders.background: Former Professor at Georgia Tech, AI researcher with expertise in NLP and machine learning.

key_leaders.name: Kevin Knieriem
key_leaders.title: Chief Revenue Officer
key_leaders.background: Former SVP at Marketo and VP at Salesforce.

facts.deployment_scale: Clari is deployed globally across thousands of enterprise users, with production usage in sales, marketing, and finance teams. The platform processes billions of data points to deliver revenue intelligence and forecasting insights.

use_cases: AI-driven insights for sales and marketing alignment
Automated data capture and activity tracking

capabilities: Automated data capture and activity tracking
Integration with CRM, marketing automation, and ERP systems

facts.gap_notes: Initial configuration and data mapping require specialized skills, but Clari provides documentation and support to mitigate gaps.

integration_requirements: Email and calendar integrations (Microsoft Outlook, Gmail)
Data warehouses and BI tools (Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI)
dependencies: API access and credentials for integrated systems
facts.complexity_notes: Pre-built integrations and well-documented APIs reduce complexity, but initial setup requires coordination with IT and RevOps teams.

facts.support_model: Enterprise-grade support with dedicated account managers, 24/7 technical support, and customer success programs.

facts.revenue_structure: Enterprise contracts tailored to user count and feature access.

facts.sales_motion: Land-and-expand within large enterprises, focusing on high-growth industries.

expansion_paths: Upsell additional features and user licenses
Cross-sell to other departments (e.g., finance, marketing)

partner_programs: Strategic alliances with CRM and marketing automation providers

facts.contracting_notes: Standard enterprise SaaS contracts with customization options for large deals. Pricing is typically based on user count and feature access.
facts.pricing_governance: Centralized pricing governance with flexibility for enterprise negotiations.

facts.fit_notes: Clari is a mature, growth-stage company with a proven enterprise sales motion, making it a strong fit for large-scale revenue operations initiatives.
